name: Beard Oil
description: TSA rules for beard oil on planes.

carryOn.reason: Beard oil is a liquid and is subject to the TSA 3-1-1 rule in carry-on bags. Containers must be 3.4 oz (100ml) or less.
conditions: Must fit in quart-sized clear bag

checkedBag.reason: Beard oil is allowed in checked baggage in any size container.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring beard oil on a plane?

travelTips: Most beard oil bottles are already under 3.4 oz — check the label before packing in carry-on

faq.question: Can I bring beard oil on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, beard oil is allowed in carry-on bags in containers of 3.4 oz (100ml) or less, placed in your quart-sized liquids bag.

faq.question: Is beard oil allowed in checked luggage?
faq.answer: Yes, beard oil in any size container is fully allowed in checked baggage.
